notes.title: Journey to Foundation Launching on PC VR
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34954051/65d6c8f488b5782053c8df911991c0319a07b9ed.png[/img]

Hello, story-based VR game enjoyers!

5 years after the release of our acclaimed underwater adventure 🤿, we are so excited to share that our story-based sci-fi adventure, Journey to Foundation, is coming to PC VR! 🌌

The game originally launched last year on other platforms.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2950330/Journey_to_Foundation/

[b]About the Game[/b]
You take on the role of Agent Ward, a galactic spy with the Commission of Public Safety, who embarks on a mission that will determine the future of humanity.

Throughout your journey, you’ll be faced with difficult choices. Decide whether to befriend or double-cross people, determine who lives or dies, and help different factions rise or fall in this branching story.

Will you fight for a dying Empire, or will you join the Foundation to help rebuild what has been lost? The future is in your hands.

[b]PC VR Version[/b]
Along with the improvements listed below, the PC version includes updated visuals and supports Windows Spatial Sound. We've also added Gamma settings, high-resolution textures & lighting, and the game runs at native 90FPS.

[b]Game Updates[/b]
Here's a quick list of general updates we made last year based on player feedback:
[list][*]Improved gesture tracking[/list][list][*]Improved combat experience[/list][list][*]Updated player tutorials[/list][list][*]Bug fixes throughout the game[/list][list][*]Meta Quest 3 visual updates[/list]
See the full list of bug fixes & game improvements [url=https://www.journeytofoundation.com/blog]on our website[/url].

✨ We can't wait for you to experience this epic sci-fi adventure! 🚀

notes.title: Update 1.04 Is Here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34954051/c9c1c471d21b432b3ff43bee87a2c99701266c5e.jpg[/img]

[h1]The 1.04 Update for FREEDIVER: Triton Down has officially arrived![/h1]
For this update, we're addressing points of feedback we've heard from players like you, including the ability to disable in-game hints, as well as improved Grip controls for those playing on VIVE headsets.

Here are the full notes!
[list]
[*] Added option to disable in-game hints (interactive FX, objective prompts, etc.)
[*] Added option to disable dynamic resolution/pixel density (Oculus only)
[*] Added option to Grip using side buttons on VIVE controllers
[*] Improved texture on vent lock asset
[*] Improved dynamic player shadow visibility
[*] Fixed "Shadow Quality" option appearing unset
[*] Fixed comfort and graphics options application bug
[*] Fixed pause menu during Prologue cinematic 
[*] Fixed death sequence when drowning
[*] Updated taskbar executable name
[/list]
What do you think about the improvements? Jump into FREEDIVER and let us know!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/995230/FREEDIVER_Triton_Down/
